# Dental Implants in Fountain Valley


Missing teeth can affect more than just your smile—they impact how you eat, speak, and feel. At Oceanic Dental in Fountain Valley, we offer advanced dental implant solutions designed to restore your health and confidence with long-lasting, natural-looking results. Our in-house team of specialists ensures your entire treatment happens under one roof—comfortably, efficiently, and with precision.

Restore Your Smile and Regain Confidence


## Dental Implants at Oceanic Dental - Fountain Valley


Dental implants at Oceanic Dental are simpler and more comfortable than you might expect. Our expert prosthodontist and oral surgeon in Fountain Valley ensure a perfect fit by assessing your oral health, bone structure, and smile goals.

Using advanced tech like CBCT scans, we make the process smooth and precise. With high-quality materials and careful planning, your implants will look and function just like natural teeth—restoring your confidence in eating, speaking, and smiling. From start to finish, we’re here with personalized, modern care to help you love your smile again!


## Why Choose Us for Dental Implants in Fountain Valley


With our trusted team and advanced technology, you can expect care that’s tailored to your needs every step of the way. Here’s why we’re your top choice for dental implants:

In-House Experts: Work with Dr. Tanaka (Prosthodontist) and Dr. Noh (Oral Surgeon) under one roof for seamless care.

Proven Excellence: Trusted throughout Orange County for high-quality dental care (recognized in the OC Register’s People’s Choice Awards, ⭐ 4.9 rating from 1,900+ patients).

Advanced Technology: We use 3D digital imaging, CBCT scans, and AI-assisted diagnostics to plan every case precisely.

Comfort-Focused Care: Sedation options and a gentle approach help ensure a stress-free experience from start to finish.

Superior Materials: We use E-max veneers, which are thinner, stronger, and more durable than traditional veneers. They resist chips, fractures, and stains, ensuring your smile stays beautiful longer.

Expert Solutions for Dark Teeth: For very dark teeth, we use Zirconia covered in clear porcelain to effectively mask discoloration while maintaining a natural look.

Expertise: Our lead dentist, Dr. Pham is an expert in cosmetic dentistry. She is a member of the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry and taught at UCSF School of Dentistry which is widely regarded as a top dental school.


## Dental Implant Options


We offer a full range of implant solutions tailored to your needs:


### Single-Tooth Implants


Replace one missing tooth with a natural-looking and permanent solution.


### Implant Bridges


Secure multiple missing teeth without relying on neighboring teeth.


### All-on-4 or All-on-X Implants


Restore your entire upper or lower arch using 4 to 6 implants to support a full set of teeth—stable, beautiful, and long-lasting.


### Snap-On Implant Dentures


Removable dentures anchored with implants for added security and comfort.

The Implant Journey: What to Expect


## Our Comprehensive Process in Fountain Valley


Dental implants are placed into the jawbone where they fuse with bone over time. The procedure typically involves three phases: planning, implant placement and healing, and finally restoration with a custom crown or denture. We use digital imaging and 3D planning for precise placement and long-term success.


###### Consultation and Planning


Start with a free consultation where you'll meet our in-house specialists, take photos, and discuss your dental needs. We evaluate your teeth, review treatment options, and answer all your questions. Using X-rays and detailed planning, we ensure your implants will be perfectly integrated and secured to your jawbone.


###### Implant Placement


We surgically place the titanium implant into your jawbone, creating a stable foundation for your new tooth. After the implant is placed, we allow time for it to integrate with the bone, ensuring a secure fit.


###### Abutment and Crown Placement


Once the implant has healed, we attach the abutment and custom-made crown. This final step restores the natural look and function of your tooth, completing your smile transformation.


## All-on-X Dental Implants with Dr. Tanaka


Dr. Tanaka - Oceanic Dental's prosthodontist in Fountain Valley - specializes in All-on-X solutions, a revolutionary approach to full-mouth restoration. All-on-X uses just 4-6 strategically placed dental implants to support a full arch of fixed, natural-looking replacement teeth. This advanced technique offers a stable, long-lasting solution for patients who are missing most or all of their teeth.


#### Immediate Results


In many cases, you can leave the office with a fully restored smile the same day.


#### Natural Look and Feel


The closest experience to natural teeth in terms of appearance, feel, and function.


#### Long-Lasting Solution


Can last a lifetime, offering a durable and reliable tooth replacement option.


#### No More Removable Dentures


Provide a secure, non-removable alternative for full-arch tooth replacement.

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about dental implant.

How much do dental implants cost in Orange County?

The cost of dental implants can range from $3,000 to $6,000 per tooth, depending on the complexity of the procedure and any additional treatments, like bone grafting. Multi-tooth implants, such as implant-supported bridges or full arch replacements (like All-on-4), can cost significantly more.

Is All-on-X better than traditional dentures?

Yes—All-on-X offers a permanent, secure, and natural-feeling solution using 4–6 implants to support a full arch. No adhesives, no slipping.

Who is a good candidate for All-on-4 dental implants?

Patients missing most or all teeth who have sufficient bone or are eligible for bone grafts are ideal candidates. A consultation with our prosthodontist can confirm.

How long does the implant process take?

Single implants typically require 3–6 months including healing. All-on-X cases may offer same-day temporary teeth with full healing over several months.

What if I need extractions or bone grafting?

We provide all treatments in-house, including gentle extractions, bone grafts, and socket preservation—so you don’t need to be referred out.

What’s the success rate of dental implants?

With proper planning and care, dental implants have a 95–98% success rate and can last decades—or a lifetime.

Are dental implants painful?

Most patients say it's easier than expected. We use local anesthesia or sedation for your comfort, and healing is usually mild.

Can I get implants in one day?

Yes. We offer same-day implant placement in select cases including All-on-X, allowing you to walk out with new teeth the same day.

Will my insurance cover implants?

Dental implant coverage depends on your insurance plan. While many dental insurance plans don’t fully cover implants, they may cover portions like extractions or crowns. Medical insurance might help if the implant is necessary due to an injury. We can help check with your provider and verify your coverage.

Why choose Oceanic Dental for implants?

We’re trusted by thousands of patients, with advanced digital planning, an in-house team of specialists, and unmatched patient care from two premier locations: Huntington Beach and Fountain Valley in Orange County.
